acceptance.given: A production change is proposed without a prior real RED test while the isolated missing-RED fixture holds all other inputs constant.

oracle.expected: The guard rejects the production change and reports the missing prior RED test as the reason.
forbidden: The change is accepted without a prior real RED test.
The fixture varies unrelated inputs or relies on a placeholder observation.
oracle.observable: The isolated missing-RED fixture emits a deterministic rejection result tied to the absent real RED test.

acceptance.then: The rejection is recorded as the fixture result and no production write is authorized.
acceptance.when: The missing-RED fixture is executed before the guarded production change.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the isolated missing-RED fixture and assert failure when the guard accepts a change lacking a prior real RED test.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce rejection of production changes that have no prior real RED test, without changing unrelated guardrails.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema or state change; reverting the guard restores prior admission behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: proposed change without real RED -> rejected by guard
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The missing-RED fixture deterministically reports rejection and no guarded production write occurs.

acceptance.given: The isolated orphan-mapping fixture runs with every input except the orphan-mapping condition held constant.

oracle.expected: Exact Cover coverage reports zero orphan nodes and provides a coverage mapping for every required node.
forbidden: Any required node remains orphaned or unmapped.
The result is inferred from a filename or an unrelated fixture.
oracle.observable: The fixture output contains an explicit no-orphans result and a complete required-node mapping.

acceptance.then: Coverage is accepted only when the explicit orphan count is zero and all required nodes are mapped.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the orphan-mapping fixture with one required node orphaned and require the coverage check to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure Exact Cover validation emits and checks complete required-node coverage with no orphan nodes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation-only change; no persisted state or schema migration is required.

slice_hint.state_transition: coverage mapping evaluated -> zero-orphan mapping accepted
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The isolated fixture reports no orphan nodes and every required node has a mapping.

acceptance.given: A frozen historical file write is attempted with bytes differing from the recorded historical bytes.

oracle.expected: The blob-comparison fixture rejects the write and preserves the original historical bytes.
forbidden: Mutated historical bytes are accepted or persisted.
The check is satisfied only by observing a generic log or filename.
oracle.observable: The isolated blob-comparison fixture returns an explicit rejection with before/after byte comparison evidence.

acceptance.then: Historical state remains unchanged after rejection.
acceptance.when: The frozen-file mutation fixture is executed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the blob-comparison fixture with altered historical bytes and require the validator to fail the attempted write.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject writes whose historical blob bytes differ from the frozen reference while retaining the original bytes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema change; historical artifacts remain immutable and compatible on rollback.

slice_hint.state_transition: frozen bytes compared -> mismatch rejected, bytes preserved
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The isolated blob-comparison fixture deterministically rejects a byte mismatch and verifies unchanged historical bytes.

acceptance.given: The isolated runtime fixture requests a write to a runtime file while all other inputs remain constant.

oracle.expected: The runtime boundary rejects the write and leaves the runtime file unchanged.
forbidden: A runtime file write is accepted or persisted.
The result is inferred from an unrelated Phase service or proxy check.
oracle.observable: The runtime fixture emits an explicit write-rejected result for the requested runtime path.

acceptance.then: No runtime file mutation is committed by the guarded operation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the runtime fixture with a write request and require failure if the guard permits or persists the runtime mutation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the runtime-path write boundary in Toolchain governance checks, rejecting runtime file writes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Policy behavior only; no persisted schema or runtime state migration is introduced.

slice_hint.state_transition: runtime write requested -> governance policy rejects write
